Carrying Apple devices out and about often means lugging a bunch of charging cables and plug adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank integrates all the accessories you need into one compact charger, solving all your hassles in one go. It features built-in foldable prongs, an integrated USB-C cable, and a magnetic charger designed specifically for the Apple Watch. This accessory is definitely a must-have in my travel kit — whether you need a quick power boost or an overnight charge, it handles everything with ease.

MagSafe Monday column: Every Monday afternoon, Bradley Chambers breaks down the latest developments in the MagSafe and wireless charging industry, helping you get the most out of your Apple devices' wireless charging capabilities.

Designed specifically for travel

The back of the RORRY Flow power bank has built-in foldable prongs, allowing you to plug it directly into a wall outlet at a hotel or vacation rental to charge the power bank, with no need to carry an extra plug. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (I really love this design!), meaning even if you want to charge your iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch or other devices, you don't need to bring an extra cable.

Although I usually focus on the iPhone's MagSafe features, this power bank has a built-in 5W magnetic charging module designed specifically for the Apple Watch. When your Apple Watch is running low on battery, just place it on top and you can easily top it up — super convenient. It holds the watch securely in place, so you can charge even without the original charger.

This power bank has a capacity of 10,000mAh, enough to keep your iPhone and Apple Watch powered all day long while traveling. For me, the most useful feature is its 40W USB-C output; even if your MacBook Air has shut down due to a dead battery, it can give you an emergency boost right away.

RORRY Flow power bank summary

If you want to travel light while bringing Apple devices, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid choice. It combines a wall charger, Apple Watch charging cable and USB-C cable into one, with a clean design that easily fits into a backpack or pocket.

You can buy the RORRY Flow portable charger directly from RORRY or Amazon.
